description: Estimate whether an LLM-serving configuration fits in memory and can meet throughput and latency targets. Returns VRAM/KV-cache breakdown, throughput and latency ranges, concurrency, cost, confidence, assumptions, and sources.

contextTokens.description: Full context length for KV cache computation (e.g., 8192 for RAG). If omitted, KV is computed for promptTokens only. Must not exceed the model's maxContext — call list_models to check.

gpu.description: Canonical tokcalc GPU ID (e.g. 'h100-sxm'). Call list_gpus first if unknown.

model.description: Canonical tokcalc model ID (e.g. 'llama3-8b'). Call list_models first if unknown.

name: estimate_capacity
